newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial Realty closes credit pact.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial Realty closes credit pact.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Tuesday it completed a $200-million unsecured credit facility co-arranged by First Chicago NBD Corp and Union Bank of Switzerland.
The company said the new pact replaces First Industrial's secured $150-million revolving facility. It expires in 2000.

"The facility represents a significant leap in First Industrial's transition from a secured borrower to an unsecured borrower and its commitment to achieveing an investment-grade rating," Michael Tomasz, First Industrial's president and chief executive officer, said.
First Industrial Realty Trust is a real estate company that focuses on warehouse and light industrial properties.
The company's stock was down 1/8 Tuesday at 28-1/4.
